source_snapshot.procedure: Select CPU in BurnInTest and check CPU/memory/network full loading for over 48 hours.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Commercial package; CPU-focused command with operator verification.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE; restores titled GPU/HDD/network coverage, safe targets and common overlap.

old_problem: The procedure/DeepSeek command under-covered the explicit five-domain Item, but the intended domains and 48-hour duration are authoritative and can drive a corrected review-layer contract.
disposition_reason: ED-04 protects storage, ED-05 preserves network identity, ED-14 preserves 48 hours, ED-15 requires signed load floors, and ED-19 forbids dropping GPU/HDD coverage. Missing package/config/targets are execution prerequisites, not review blockers.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row73 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3102 and actual next row74/history3103 were read.
The Item explicitly enumerates GPU, CPU, memory, HDD and network; the review-layer procedure corrects the incomplete CPU selection without reducing coverage.
All five domains must share one 48-hour overlap with safe storage identities and mapped peers.
Commercial package/license, thresholds and confirmation remain hard execution gates; no stress ran.

test_case.purpose: Verify the full system sustains all five titled domains concurrently for 48 hours without data, compute, link, thermal, RAS or service failure.
required_package: Safe storage targets and network peers
test_case.test_command: After package, target and user approval, start the pinned BurnInTest configuration selecting GPU, CPU, memory, approved HDD targets and network peers, prove all load floors overlap continuously for 48 hours, then stop, collect evidence and restore state.
test_case.expected_result: Every domain remains above its signed load floor for the common 48 hours with no data mismatch, XID/ECC/RAS, storage, link, thermal/power, heartbeat or tool/platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all five domains and full common duration; CPU-only, incidental activity, unsafe disks, short fio or staggered jobs cannot pass.
safety_gate: Immutable safe storage and peer mappings
Abort on data, XID/ECC/RAS, storage/link, thermal/power or heartbeat fault; no auto-retry
test_case.recovery: Stop all modules coherently, preserve evidence, protect/quarantine affected storage, restore network/tool configuration and services, and do not restart automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Review-layer coverage follows the explicit five-domain Item and treats CPU-only procedure text as incomplete, not permission to reduce scope.

blocked.reason: Purpose/domains/duration are clear; package and project parameters are execution gates.
